# FlyFreshFlight.com

> > Travel blog by Dale Richard featuring sustainable outdoor adventures, destination guides, and eco-friendly travel stories from destinations like Cancún, Chichen Itza, and wilderness areas across North America.

FlyFreshFlight.com is a personal travel blog focused on sustainable and eco-conscious exploration of natural destinations, combining outdoor adventure with environmental awareness. The site covers camping, hiking, and cultural experiences from the Appalachian Mountains to the Great Maya Reef.
